prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity 16:9 desktop homepage direction comp, a real shippable 1920x1080 web interface screenshot
Input images: Image 1 is the visual quality-bar board for cereal-red, sunrise-yellow and coated-card merchandising grammar; Image 2 is the matching homepage quality-bar showing modular product facings in a usable web UI; Image 3 is the authoritative VEEMAP orange-and-green twin-chevron logo, preserve its geometry and colors accurately in the top-left brand lockup
Primary request: Design "Technology Planogram", a bold VEEMAP Technologies homepage that translates tightly arranged retail planogram/facing logic into a serious industrial capability system. The exact central hero object is a physically credible, conceptually accurate, non-proprietary high-speed special-purpose assembly machine. Show it at a deliberate mid-explosion scroll keyframe: guarded structural frame and conveyor stay anchored while a servo pick-and-place gantry, AI camera inspection station, HMI/control cabinet, and compact machine-health sensor module move outward on plausible assembly axes into four adjacent capability facings. Those modules must clearly belong to the same machine and be able to return to one assembled state with the same camera, scale and lighting.
Scene/backdrop: warm coated-board cream canvas with bold cereal red and sunrise yellow structural panels, deep ink-navy outlines, subtle gloss and paper fiber; no grocery aisle and no factory photo
Style/medium: ultra-premium industrial web UI using the confident color blocking, curved label bands, burst geometry, coated-package materiality and modular facings of the references, but stripped of all childish cues; precise engineering composition, crisp product visualization, restrained depth, serious manufacturing credibility
Composition/framing: landscape desktop browser viewport. Cream top navigation with authentic VEEMAP logo lockup at left, compact links, and a red primary CTA at right. Below, a two-thirds-width hero: oversized red headline field on left/top, the exploded machine dominant in the center, and a cream/yellow vertical rail of four substantial capability cards on the right. Each card contains one plausible isolated machine module with a thin leader line back to its installed location; cards feel like shippable clickable web components, not packaging art. Along the bottom, a horizontal proof bar and four small numbered build-stage tabs create a clear scroll-story interface.
Lighting/mood: confident coated-catalog warmth with hard clean industrial studio lighting on brushed aluminum, safety glass, black polymer, electrical enclosures and small orange accents; optimistic and high-energy, yet sober enough for plant leaders and procurement teams
Text (verbatim, render only these phrases): "VEEMAP TECHNOLOGIES"; "SPECIAL PURPOSE MACHINES"; "BUILT FOR THE EXACT PROCESS."; "ENGINEERED TO MOVE. CHECK. THINK."; "AI VISION"; "HIGH-SPEED MOTION"; "INDUSTRY 4.0 HMI"; "PREDICTIVE HEALTH"; "TELL US ABOUT YOUR PROCESS"; "236 PROJECTS DELIVERED"; "SCROLL TO BUILD"
Constraints: The central object must read as one real engineered industrial automation machine, not four unrelated products. Use only non-proprietary conceptual geometry and reveal no sensitive construction details. Show clear navigation, buttons, content hierarchy, responsive margins, credible card interactions and a visible scroll affordance. Capability callouts must connect to plausible matching machine components. Preserve the VEEMAP twin-chevron logo accurately from Image 3. High fidelity, 16:9.
Avoid: mascots; cartoon eyes; cereal boxes; food; supermarket photography; childish rounded illustration; poster-only composition; sci-fi holograms; fantasy robotics; humanoid robots; weapons; client logos; certification seals; fake awards; unverified performance claims; additional statistics; fine proprietary mechanisms; illegible microcopy; gibberish text; watermarks
